items.title: Dolly Douroux Adams Interview, 1962-04-18
items.q: Big I, Lloyd. He's got a good memory. He can refresh my memory.

ctx.x: Boy, yeah. That part of that to you whether it was Crossford River going to a job or a bias of when he turned the skiff over and everything.
You see, there's a lot of things that skips my memory, you know? Big I, Lloyd. He's got a good memory. He can refresh my memory.
Chris, uh... Chris Kelly, probably. Chris Kelly. Chris Kelly. They worked together. Grandpa often told us about those guys.
